arguments.command:
cd /workspace && OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/workspace/native PYTHONPATH=/workspace/.deps:/workspace/submission python3 - <<'EOF'
import sys, importlib
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
mods=[
 'protocol','te','te.session','te.engine','te.engine.qp','te.engine.worker','te.engine.controller',
 'te.path_providers','te.path_providers.base','te.path_providers.sparse_ops',
 'te.algorithms','te.algorithms.sub_algorithms','te.algorithms.sub_algorithms.simplex_projection',
 'te.algorithms.sub_algorithms.pgd','te.algorithms.sub_algorithms.admm',
 'te.algorithms.sub_algorithms.mlu_backends','te.algorithms.sub_algorithms.mlu_backends.pdlp_mlu',
 'te.algorithms.communication','te.algorithms.communication.partial_barrier',
 'te.algorithms.formulations','te.algorithms.formulations.path_based',
 'te.algorithms.formulations.path_based.distributed',
 'te.algorithms.formulations.path_based.distributed.worker',
 'te.algorithms.formulations.path_based.distributed.coordinator',
 'array_utils','array_utils.cpu','array_utils.cpu.types','array_utils.cpu.wrapper',
 'main',
]
bad=0
for m in mods:
    try:
        importlib.import_module(m)
    except Exception as e:
        bad+=1; print("IMPORT FAIL",m,type(e).__name__,e)
print("imports ok" if not bad else "failures %d"%bad)
EOF
